title: NIST WebBook: Ammonia is H3N, molecular weight 17.0305 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Ammonia as H3N, molecular weight 17.0305 amu, CAS 7664-41-7.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Ammonia, CAS Registry Number 7664-41-7, lists molecular formula H3N and molecular weight 17.0305 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 17.0265491010 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/H3N/h1H3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
